claims.claim: This is a Used Nikon D3400 DSLR Camera
claims.evidence: Witness could not read the body's model text in any photo; only the Nikon logo is visible, not the D3400 designation.
Photo 1 shows lens barrel text reading 'Nikon AF-P DX Nikkor 70-300mm 1:4.5-6.3G ED'.

claims.claim: Working perfectly ok with no fault
claims.evidence: No power-on, shutter-fire, or screen-function shot/clip in the report.
No photo of camera menu/shutter-count screen or third-party counter tool output.

claims.claim: No fungus or scratch on the lens
claims.evidence: Report explicitly lists lens glass clarity as not shown.
No battery or charger visible in any photo; report lists presence of these as not shown.
No internal, serial, or service-sticker evidence available remotely.

risks.risk: Body model may not actually be a D3400 (could be a different, possibly lower-value, Nikon body).
risks.proof: Clear photo of the model name printed on the front or top of the camera body, or the menu 'camera info' screen.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic/unspecified entry-level Nikon DSLR body, not guaranteed D3400.

risks.risk: Camera may have faults despite seller's claim (AF, buttons, LCD, sensor).
risks.proof: Short power-on video showing menu navigation, autofocus racking, and a live test shot.

risks.risk: Shutter count could be much higher than claimed, affecting mechanical lifespan.
risks.proof: Screenshot of in-camera shutter count or output from a shutter-count checking tool/software.

risks.risk: Lens may have internal fungus, haze, or scratches not visible from exterior barrel shots.
risks.proof: Photo of lens held up against a bright light showing the glass elements clearly, front and rear.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as lens condition unknown, possible optical defect.

risks.risk: Battery/charger may be missing or third-party, despite 'original' claim.
risks.proof: Photo of battery and charger with visible Nikon branding/model numbers alongside the camera.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as body+lens only, accessories not confirmed.

risks.risk: Visible grip wear/scuffing suggests heavier use than a low shutter count would imply.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of grip, mode dial, and underside/tripod mount for overall cosmetic and use assessment.
risks.if_unproven: Priced reflecting visible cosmetic wear as heavy-use cosmetic grade.

proof_requests: Photo of the camera body's front/top showing the model name clearly (confirm D3400 or otherwise).
Power-on video showing menu, autofocus operation, and a test shutter fire.
Screenshot or photo of the in-camera shutter count screen.
Photo of the lens held to light showing front and rear glass elements for fungus/scratches/haze.
Photo of the battery and charger together with the camera, showing brand/model markings.
Close-up of underside/tripod mount and LCD screen for additional cosmetic assessment.
response.reason: The witness confirms a Nikon DSLR body with a 70-300mm Nikkor lens, so it can be priced at worst case given the body model, functionality, shutter count, lens condition, and accessories are all unverified or unverifiable remotely.
